author: Nina Deleon
title: 73-Year-Old School Bus Driver Arrested for Allegedly Strangling a Student
text:
Nationwide — Effie Wynn, a 73-year-old African American school bus driver from Lynchburg, Virginia, was arrested after allegedly strangling a student on the bus while parked at a school. Police say she faces strangulation and child neglect charges.
Lynchburg police responded to Linkhorne Elementary School on March 30 after reports of a “disorderly individual.” When officers arrived, they began investigating an incident reported inside a school bus parked on school property.
According to WSET, the investigation revealed that Wynn allegedly assaulted the student on the bus during the encounter. Police worked with Lynchburg City Schools during the inquiry and determined that the child was strangled.
Authorities confirmed the student was safe following the incident and did not suffer life-threatening injuries. Officials did not release additional details about the child’s condition.
Wynn was taken into custody on April 4 and formally charged with strangulation and child neglect. Police said the case remains under active investigation, with more updates expected as new information is verified. School officials continue to cooperate with law enforcement as the investigation moves forward.
